messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
['We would like to notify you that Lloyds Bank carries out client details verification procedure that is compulsory for all our customers.', 'Your account has been placed on hold', 'You have 1 unread message(s)...', 'Michael J. Clarke made an online funds transfer to your account online.', 'Your account information was violated.', 'This e-mail has been sent to you by HSBC UK to inform you that we were unable to verify your account details.', 'Your account has been restricted from withdrawing and sending funds due to several logon attempts from different IP.', "It's either your information has been changed or incomplete, as a result your access to use our services has been limited.", 'HSBC has temporarily suspended your online banking access.', 'A scheduled maintenance has just been completed on the ANZ Internet Banking system.', 'The information do not match our record.', 'We are contacting you to remind you that our Account Review Team identified some unusual activity in your account.', 'We were able to trace it to an unknown link thereby, placing your online banking on suspension till this is resolved.', 'We recently failed to validate your payment information, therefore we need to ask you to complete a short verification process in order to verify your account.', 'your account will be deactivated within the next 48 hours due to several unsuccessful login attempt on your account.', 'Your new official monthly statement is now available for you to view online.', 'This message confirms that you have changed your Lloyds TSB Security details.', 'our monitoring process has temporarily suspended your online banking access.', 'On routine audit check last month, I discovered some investment accounts that has been dormant for the last twelve(12) years.', 'We recently noticed one or more attempts to log in your Halifax Online banking Account From a foreign IP address, and we have reasons to believe that your account was hijacked by third party without your authorization.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
